completion_data.completion_summary: Added model: opus to YAML frontmatter of all 17 core and 15 extension mirror command files. Updated command template, creating-commands guide, and agent frontmatter standard to mandate model: opus as required.

memory_candidates.content: When standardizing frontmatter across command files, use sed with pattern '0,/^description: /{ /^description: /a\model: opus\n}' to insert after the first description line only. This avoids duplicate insertions and respects files with varying frontmatter lengths.
